text:
cheng: Quick heads-up — doing a security baseline sweep for the new ap-nrt-gpu2 cluster tomorrow 08:00 UTC. Need owners for IAM, secrets, KMS/HSM, network ACLs, and final handoff. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-region-boot
maria: I can own IAM & roles. Will run role-binding matrix and least-priv check. Ping me if you need access to test accounts.
akshay: I'll take KMS/HSM and key wrapping checks. Need to confirm HSM staging endpoint + KMS key policy. Can we get rotation creds for the test key? :+1:
devops-bot: preflight checklist created: https://redwood.internal/checks/2167092473 — uses iam-validate.sh, kms-audit.sh, secrets-scan.
cheng: Maria, sample command for role check:
```
aws iam get-role --role-name redwood-gpu-node-role | jq '.Role.AssumeRolePolicyDocument'
```
look for "sts:AssumeRole" trust only from node instance-profile and deployment service accounts.
maria: Copy. I'll run that against staging and paste failures.
sam-sre: Network note: make sure egress to HSM endpoint on 10.2.5.14:443 allowed in cluster subnets; we had it blocked in the last region. Also check route table priorities.
lina-sec: Secrets: confirm all node boot tokens are stored in vault with kv-v2, ensure auto-rotate enabled. Run `vault kv metadata get secret/gpu/nodes` and verify versions >1.
akshay: KMS sanity quick check:
```
gcloud kms keys versions list --key redwood-gpu-key --location=asia-northeast1
``` 
expect primary state and only approved key versions.
cheng: Also cost/quota reminder — provisioning 8xA100 initially. Watch quota bump request and preemptible ratio; file ticket if quotas insufficient.
maria: Starting IAM run now, will post failures here. ETA 45m.
achshay: Starting KMS/HSM checks now. If anyone has the HSM bastion key, DM me. :lock:
cheng: Thanks — will collate and run final handoff doc once both IAM & KMS green. :pray:
